ORDER re: 12 MOTION for Preliminary Injunction . filed by Success Academy Charter Schools-NYC. On September 16, 2026, Plaintiff filed a motion for a preliminary injunction. ECF No. 12; see also ECF Nos. 13-16. Unless and until the C ourt orders otherwise, Defendant shall file any opposition to the motion by October 2, 2026, and shall file a single, consolidated brief opposing the motion and supporting Defendant's anticipated motion to dismiss; Plaintiff shall file a single, consolidated brief in opposition to Defendant's motion to dismiss and in further support of its motion for a preliminary injunction by October 23, 2026; and Defendant shall file any reply in support of her motion to dismiss by October 30, 2026. The parties should address in their briefs whether there is a need for an evidentiary hearing in connection with the motion for a preliminary injunction and whether trial on the merits should be advanced and consolidated with any preliminary injunct ion hearing. See FED. R. CIV. P. 65(a)(2). The foregoing schedule supersedes the schedule previously set for Defendant's anticipated motion to dismiss. See ECF No. 11. If either party believes that the schedule should be modified in any way, the parties should promptly confer and seek appropriate relief. SO ORDERED. (Signed by Judge Jesse M. Furman on 9/17/2026) (Replies due by 10/30/2026. Responses due by 10/23/2026) (ar) Order AND ~Util - Set Deadlines

The parties should join the conference by calling the Court's dedicated conference line at (855) 244-8681 and using access code 2303 019 3884, followed by the pound (#) key.
